mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 195.0 signals accelerating inflation, which triggers a monetary policy response and negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 195.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%) and strong employment growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month) signals a tight labor market that may lead to inflationary pressures and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both conditions are met (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 2000 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO reading below 115.0 signals a contraction in industrial production, indicating economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 115.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST growth > 0.5% month-over-month) and rising residential fixed investment (RSAFS growth > 0.5% month-over-month) signals a strong housing market that drives economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both conditions are met (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to economic uncertainty and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
